direction.name: OFFLINE MOCK: Sea-Grape Veranda House
direction.concept: A low, deep-eaved island house: one long living pavilion and a quieter bedroom wing form an L around a shaded south garden with a small pool.
hierarchy: Living pavilion under the main hip roof
Bedroom wing as a lower secondary mass
direction.roofLanguage: Terracotta clay hip roofs with deep shading eaves; the pavilion roof is the crown.
direction.entrance: A modest covered north entrance into a bright foyer.
direction.outdoorLiving: A deep timber-beamed veranda across the living rooms opening to a pool terrace.
direction.landscape: Palms and layered tropical borders around an open lawn.

blocks.role: Main living pavilion with kitchen, dining and principal suite

openSpaces.role: Covered garden veranda along the living pavilion
Pool reservation in the south garden off the bedroom wing

pool.intentResolution: Stage 5 resolves conceptual reservation pool-reservation (9.2×7.4 m at -14, 6.7) as one plunge 6×3 m pool whose full deck envelope is 9.2×7.4 m, centred at -14.0, 14.7; close separation clears the accepted house front.

design.statement: OFFLINE MOCK: palms, layered borders and a plunge pool on the reserved garden pad.
